calendarFeeds.title: My calendar feeds
calendarFeeds.lede: Your roadmap's regulatory dates, in any calendar app.
calendarFeeds.about: Never your bank's own notes, cases or internal deadlines — only public dates.
calendarFeeds.newFeedBody: Paste it into your calendar app to see these dates there.
calendarFeeds.newFeedOnce: It is not shown again, and anyone holding it can read your roadmap. Revoke it here if it leaks.
calendarFeeds.revokeBody: It stops working right away. Until now, anyone holding the address could see which regulatory changes your bank has open work on.
calendarFeeds.emptyBody: Subscribe to see your roadmap in a calendar app.
calendarFeeds.errorTitle: Could not load your calendar feeds
